cases.assertion: Checked literal evidence satisfies the secret contract without a fabricated graph; deployment assumptions remain in POC readiness.
Inspect the static registration and Auth implementation; query truncation alone does not establish unknown reachability.
A shell injection claim and a single-argument option injection claim are distinct; blocked shell evaluation needs scoped counter-evidence.
Assess the actual uploaded filename and save/delete operation; do not assert a matched dependency implementation unavailable in the repository.
Environment configuration control differs from remote request control; unresolved configuration trust boundaries remain explicit.
A request trigger does not establish influence over a literal destination; an adjacent race does not decide the SSRF claim.
ReadBody writes remote request bodies; ordinary application writes do not establish symlink prepositioning or replacement capability.
The writer mutex does not cover PrintFlag; a returned constant marker does not prove file-content disclosure.
Auth is registered in InitRouter and only sets a header; identifying an authentication vulnerability still requires a protected operation and impact.
A checked whole function body is not merely a reused route declaration; body evidence remains frozen and source validated.
Ordinary traversal and preexisting symlink traversal require separate mechanisms and preconditions.
Receiving an external signal is not synchronization with server initialization in a separate goroutine.
Compare the same configuration trust boundary with the related candidate without borrowing evidence refs.
Debug mode is a review signal, not proof of a concrete disclosure or deployed security impact.
Separate source-visible growth and limits from unobserved deployment bounds; an executed exhaustion POC is not a static verdict prerequisite.
Compare exact static exposure mechanisms and inspect Auth before attributing control to it.
Use the same server lifecycle facts as the startup candidate; a static race and its demonstrated security impact are separate judgments.
Do not merge same-site state claims unless their actor, mechanism and remedy agree; preserve local directory replacement unknowns.
Reuse checked process operation semantics for taxonomy compatibility without treating them as proof of an exploitable option or impact.
Option support and single-token impact may depend on an unavailable external executable; preserve that boundary.
External executable integrity requires an attacker-controlled deployment capability; do not merge it with argument injection merely because the API is shared.

acceptance: Execution validity, source authority, candidate identity and scoped reasoning are assessed separately. Existing model statuses are not semantic ground truth. Real external unknowns need not become confirmed or rejected.
